clauses.clause_label: Personal evaluation, private learning, and internal testing
clauses.scope_note: Permits viewing and using the repository and included materials only for personal evaluation, private learning, or non-commercial internal testing; it does not expressly grant copying, modification, or other rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: The use must be for at least one of the stated purposes, and internal testing must be non-commercial.

clauses.clause_label: Restrictions on redistribution and commercial or revenue-generating use
clauses.scope_note: Without the copyright holder’s prior written permission, prohibits redistributing, mirroring, republishing, repackaging, sublicensing, or selling the project or any substantial part; and using the project, its prompts, rules, workflows, documents, or derivatives in commercial products, paid services, SaaS products, consulting delivery, training packages, marketplace listings, or other revenue-generating use. Permission is an exception to these restrictions, not an unconditional grant.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when prior written permission from the copyright holder has not been obtained. The distribution restriction is expressly scoped to the project or a substantial part; the commercial-use restriction also covers the listed materials and derivatives.

clauses.scope_note: Prohibits removing or altering copyright, license, contact, or usage-restriction notices without prior written permission from the copyright holder.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies unless the copyright holder has given prior written permission.

coverage_notes: The repository and included materials are described as protected by copyright; the supplied text is a restricted-use license, not a conventional software license. It does not expressly grant copying, modification, source provision, training, or other rights beyond the stated viewing and use permission; reserved rights are not converted into separate prohibitions on every unmentioned activity.
The restriction on claiming authorship, ownership, or exclusive rights is omitted because the allowed activity taxonomy has no corresponding activity.
The Chinese text repeats the English terms; it is not extracted as a separate clause.
